description:
Progress of a catalog import started with import_channel_catalog. status is queued, running, completed or failed, with counts: pages read, listings seen, created, updated, ours (listings ApparelHub made, linked to their product), removed (left the channel since the last import) and images_fetched. A failed run states `error`; what was read before it stopped is kept and nothing is marked removed on a partial pass. Poll every few seconds while queued/running. Read-only.

[#f0059c]

store_uuid.description: The store uuid the import was started on.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: get_catalog_import_run
